strategy: seasonal visual envelope v8 seamless surface using the proven v7 continuous motion engine and mounted foreground media

envelope_motion.reason: Envelope v8 preserves the proven v7 shared coordinate field while removing presentation seams and independent-card styling; GitHub README images remain independent documents, so no shared runtime clock is claimed.

constraints: GitHub page chrome cannot be overlaid or restyled from README content.
The envelope is limited to the README rendering area.
Static composition must remain complete if animation is unavailable.
Dark theme is the design authority for this experiment.
Automatic promotion may only use season entries with auto_promote=true and static_render=PASS.
The live README references only stable assets; seasonal source paths stay inside the design lab.
Optional animation must not carry essential information and must expose a reduced-motion fallback.
Do not add a separator immediately after the hero when direct visual flow is stronger.
Projects and Activity labels and the attribution band are font-independent vector geometry.
Moving rail objects belong to one logical global field; a local SVG is only a clipping viewport into that field.
Local boundary opacity fades are forbidden; partial geometry must leave and enter through clipping instead.
All logical Y spans are rendered; invisible content gaps are represented by visible background canvas surfaces.
Third-party character media remains a normal README image and is never copied into repository-owned SVG bytes.
The character image is mounted between two repository-owned side surfaces; each side surface maps its local X back to the common 900px coordinate system.
Repository-owned Project Map and contribution SVG bodies may be composed into generated 900px canvas stages so their real data remains authoritative while the background fills the full width.
Cross-document animation remains phase-tolerant rather than hard-synchronized; do not claim a shared runtime clock.
Hero, character surfaces, attribution, bridges, section bands, mounted canvases and footer use one continuous rectangular surface; independent rounded-card styling is forbidden inside the envelope.
README profile images use top vertical alignment so inline-image baseline/descender spacing cannot create visible seams between logical windows.

Short contiguous logical windows may share one taller physical SVG document when needed to stay above GitHub README line-height after responsive scaling; the packed document must retain the original global start/end coordinates and must not delete logical spans.
The name hero is the first window of the same envelope rather than an independent card; it must not carry its own inset card border.
Hero top cap, continuous background surfaces, shared rails, bridges, section bands, and footer bottom cap use one global coordinate grammar.
A seasonal motion live_verification PASS is scoped to a tested target surface/environment and must be re-earned after a renderer/version change or seasonal promotion.
